string.text: While enabled, the wheel uses the selected actions instead of weapon switching. Disabling this restores wheel weapon switching. Keyboard bindings work independently.
Choose what scrolling up does. None does nothing outside zoom and menus. The invert option swaps the two directions.
Choose what scrolling down does. Scope zoom, binocular magnification and PDA/menu scrolling are always preserved.
Swap the scroll up and scroll down actions. Existing inverted-scroll settings are retained.
Minimum time between wheel actions, from 0 to 500 milliseconds. Useful to prevent accidental repeated toggles. Zero applies every notch.
Bind a key to raise the weapon without holstering it. Escape clears the binding. Aim/zoom and menus keep their normal controls.
Bind a key to lower the weapon without holstering it. Escape clears the binding.
Bind one key to switch between raised and lowered stance. It does not holster the weapon. Escape clears the binding.
Enable the selected holster/draw key and behavior. Turn this off to leave the game Lower/Raise Weapon key unchanged. Wheel holster actions are independent.
Use the game Lower/Raise Weapon binding (B by default), or select a separate custom binding below. A custom binding leaves the original game key unchanged unless that same key is assigned here.
Used only when the key source is Custom key. Escape clears this binding. With no custom key assigned, holstering by custom key is disabled.
Toggle holsters the equipped item or draws the last one. Holster only puts it away; Draw only draws the last item when hands are empty.

Click a key control and press the desired key; Escape clears it. Use different keys for raise, lower, toggle and holster. Duplicate keys run only one action (raise, lower, toggle, then holster). Menus, dialogs, PDA and aiming retain their normal controls. Defaults match the original mod. Custom key bindings require MCM 1.6 or newer.
